newsitem.title: USA: Groups seek to block Battle Mountain mine.
newsitem.headline: Groups seek to block Battle Mountain mine.

text.p: Battle Mountain Gold Co said Wednesday some special-interest groups are seeking an injunction against U.S. Forest Service on Crown Resources Corp's Crown Jewel gold-mine project in Washington state.
Battle Mountain said the groups are appealing the Forest service's decision upholding the record of decision and environmental impact statement for the Crown Jewel mine.
The company noted it is earning a 54 percent interest in the project.
The appeal was filed in U.S. District Court and indicates the interest groups will seek injunctive relief, Battle Mountain said.
The company said it expects the Forest Service to contest the appeal.

Battle Mountain said the appeal essentially raises the same claims previously denied by the Forest Service. The effect and duration of the appeal, or any other appeals related to the permitting, is difficult to predict, it added.

Efforts to obtain the required construction and development permits for the mine continue, Battle Mountain said. Some affirmative permit decisions were already received, and the scheduling agreement between the company and Washington agencies provides timelines for making remaining state permit decisions.
